| colspan="6" align="left" style="width:50px";|'''Notes:'''{{refbegin}}{{note|immunity|1}} After switching tribes, Ambre and Setha were given individual immunity at the following Tribal Council should their new tribe lose the corresponding Immunity Challenge.<br />{{note|deadlock|2}} A deadlocked tie occurred, thus forcing the tied castaways to draw rocks to determine who would be eliminated.<br />{{note|ambassadors|3}} At the ambassadors meeting, the two ambassadors agreed to vote Setha out of the game.<br />{{note|necklace|4}} An Immunity Necklace was played, however, no votes were cast against its user.<br />{{note|suddendeath|5}} The castaway who finished last in the second individual Immunity Challenge would be eliminated from the game. Pauline came in last and was eliminated.<br />{{note|tieddestinies|6}} Louana was Maxime's partner during the Tied Destinies twist, therefore she was also eliminated when Maxime was voted out.<br />{{note|amulet|7}} After finishing first in the Reward Challenge, Bastien also received individual immunity at Tribal Council in the form of an Immunity Amulet.<br />{{note|suddendeath2|8}} The castaway who finished last in the Reward Challenge and two other castaways chosen by the winners of the challenge competed in another challenge where the castaway who finished last would be eliminated from the game. Olga and Jean-Charles won and remained in the game while Fouzi was eliminated.<br />{{note|necklace2|9}} An Immunity Necklace was played, negating all votes against its user.<br />{{note|finalfive|10}} At the final five, the remaining castaways competed in an elimination challenge where the castaway finishing last would be eliminated from the game. Ambre came in last and was eliminated.<br />{{note|finalfour|11}} By virtue of winning the final Immunity Challenge, and due to the Final Three, Géraldine chose François as his first opponent. The latter then picked Bastien to be the third finalist. Therefore, Jean-Charles was voted out.<br />{{note|jurytie|12}} According to the rules of Koh-Lanta, if a tie for Sole Survivor occurs, two of the three finalists are declared winners.
{{refend}}
